questions.question: The prophet Micah said the corrupt leaders of Jacob will one day cry out to the LORD. What will the LORD do?

answers.text: He will answer them right away
He will send them a new king

questions.question: The prophet Micah said he was filled with power to speak out against Israel's sin. Where did that power come from?
The prophet Micah accused the priests of Jerusalem of teaching for a price. True or false?
Because of its corrupt leaders, what did the prophet Micah say would happen to Zion?

answers.text: It would be plowed like a field
It would be rebuilt with gold
It would be ruled by Egypt
